messages:
maria: Quick design check on the prompt-sets > runs page. Ran into a11y + filter UX issues when triaging regressions — starting a short thread to capture fixes.

jay: Which filters/flows are hitting problems?

maria: Filters are: status (all/passing/failing), model, run date, tags, plus the 'show regressions' toggle. Problems: keyboard nav skips the dropdowns, pill list feels cluttered, and results updates aren't announced to screen readers (no aria-live).

elena: Agree re: aria-live. Screen readers need an announcement when results update after applying filters. Suggest adding aria-live="polite" to the results count/heading.

sam: Also: the 'Show regressions only' control is pretty buried — people expect it upfront. Consider a segmented control next to search so it’s discoverable.

jay: I like moving it left of search. Rename label to 'Regressions only' (shorter). Makes it easy for CI users who check failing runs fast.

maria: Copy tweak note: scorecard CTAs now read 'Run tests' and 'Approve suite' which is ambiguous. Propose: 'Run prompt suite' and 'Approve test results' to be explicit.

elena: For approval flow: show a short inline diff summary (top 3 changes) right above the approve button. Keyboard users should expand diff details with Enter; if modal opens, add a focus trap.

sam: Performance: applying multiple filters currently re-fetches full payload each time. Suggest debounce on filter changes + an incremental summary endpoint so counts update instantly while full payload loads.

jay: Design nit on diffs: when rows are compacted we lose context. Add a keyboard+hover reveal (e.g., '...') to expand snippet inline. Make truncation indicators accessible (aria-describedby pointing to full-context label).

maria: Dev acceptance list (short): 1) aria-live results count; 2) keyboard-only expand/collapse for diffs; 3) move regressions toggle left of search; 4) update copy to 'Run prompt suite' / 'Approve test results'; 5) debounce filter changes to 250ms and use incremental counts. Anything missing?

elena: Add testing checklist: VoiceOver + NVDA smoke (2025 versions), keyboard-only navigation test, color-contrast check for diff highlights (>=4.5).

sam: :thumbsup: I'll prototype debounce + partial-results API. Backend note: please expose a lightweight /runs/summary returning counts per filter combo.

jay: I'll update the Figma mock and add an interactive prototype illustrating keyboard flows. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria: Thanks — I'll open a PR with the copy and acceptance criteria, link the Figma, and tag owners. tagging @sam @jay @elena for follow-ups. /cc @devops-bot to flag any rollout constraints.
